questions.q: What should a staff engineer ask first when given 'we need better forecasting'?
options: Which decision will change and who acts on it
why: Correct: value comes from changing a decision.

questions.q: Review period 7 days, lead time 3 days. What is the minimum forecast horizon in days?
questions.why: Horizon = lead time + review period = 3 + 7 = 10 days.

questions.q: Under-stock costs 9 and over-stock costs 1. What is the critical ratio?
questions.why: 9 / (9 + 1) = 0.9. Plan for the 90th percentile of demand.

questions.q: Scenario: costs are equal for over- and under-forecast. Which target is best?
why: Correct: with symmetric costs the central forecast is the right target (the median for absolute cost).

questions.q: Scenario: a pricing team changes prices weekly, and demand depends on price. A pure forecast model is likely to:
options: Miss the effect of the team's own decisions; you may need a causal or optimisation model
why: Correct: the decision changes the future, so forecasting alone is not enough.

why: You cannot learn without a test.

questions.q: Which line belongs in a decision canvas?
options: What the actor does today without the model
why: Correct: today's process is the baseline that you must beat.
